entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Could you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order here for the Pro-Lace cycling shoes, delivered about 43 days ago. Is that correct?
Alright. To make sure I process this correctly for you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They're just awful. No matter how I position the cleats, they give me terrible blisters after every ride. It's been a fantastic experience.
I'm very sorry to hear that they're causing blisters. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just review our return policy for you.
Okay, I've checked the policy, and you're well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Whatever. Just tell me what I need to do.

Of course. I have just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. You should see it arrive in the next few minutes. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be issued back to your original payment method.
Great. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
